verdict.rationale: Shortcut ships a first-party, no-code "Automations" feature, but the evidence shows only preset behaviors (auto-start/auto-complete Epics, auto-create Iterations, roll over unfinished Stories). Nothing shows a PM composing their own multi-step workflows. The REST API is a developer building block and earns no credit here. missing for 10: a user-configurable trigger/condition/action builder, chaining of multiple steps into custom workflows, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the automation feature.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Automations Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
